sages.name: MELCHIOR
sages.notes: Claude Code headless. Prompt is piped via stdin. .result holds the final text. Headless denies network tools by default; WebSearch/WebFetch are allowlisted so research mode works. Keep this variadic flag last.

sages.name: BALTHASAR
sages.notes: Runs through the bundled codex-sage.sh wrapper, which starts codex exec with the operator's MCP servers, plugins and apps switched off so the question does not reach a fourth provider. cli stays 'codex' because that is what preflight must find. The prompt arrives on stdin via the trailing '-'; the final message goes to ANSWER_FILE. read-only sandbox: an opinion never needs to write files.

sages.name: CASPER
sages.notes: Grok Build headless. Prompt is passed as a file path. schema_args is appended when the host supplies a schema. permission-mode auto is required: without it tool use stalls on an approval prompt nobody can answer and the run ends with stopReason Cancelled. Because auto would also approve the operator's MCP tools, --tools limits the built-ins to search and fetch and --deny 'MCPTool(*)' blocks MCP calls, keeping the question inside the three announced providers. The MCP tool schemas remain listed to the model; only calling them is refused.
